## The multiplier

AI only multiplies what you already know. I've built these systems by hand across four platforms, so I can tell good output from plausible output and fix the difference myself. The engineering decisions stay with me. Agents take the volume.

<table>
<tr><th align="left" width="50%">What I own</th><th align="left" width="50%">What AI speeds up</th></tr>
<tr><td valign="top">
System architecture and data models<br>
Auth, security and payments (Mobile Money, bank)<br>
Performance work, like on-device video encoding<br>
Debugging the problems agents can't see<br>
Review of every diff before it merges
</td><td valign="top">
Scaffolding and boilerplate<br>
Test coverage<br>
Refactors that touch dozens of files<br>
Porting a feature across platforms<br>
Docs and first drafts of specs
</td></tr>
</table>

**How a project runs:** <code>SPEC.md</code> → <code>architecture</code> → <code>CLAUDE.md</code> → <code>parallel agents</code> → <code>review + ship</code><br>
**Toolkit:** Claude Code · Cursor · Cline · MCP · LLM APIs
